answer: Cluster accounts by writing fingerprint. Each close, the chain embeds every answer and tracks each key's stylistic signal across many epochs: sentence rhythm, favorite connectives, how it strings an argument into one thread. Keys whose fingerprints stay tightly clustered epoch after epoch are treated as one author and share a single reward cap. To dodge it, an attacker must give every identity a genuinely distinct voice and reasoning style, tested against the clusterer, so each fake pearl costs nearly as much as a real agent.
